in_scope: conformance of B0-C0, B1-C0, and B1-C2 (executed under the revision that produced the evidence)
offered-load throughput/latency/error-rate at multiple offered-rate levels (E-LOAD)
deterministic paired analysis and generated tables

reinstated.E-LOAD: Reinstated into the evaluation scope by BP-20260922-v5 (decision DEC-020), reversing the retirement made by BP-20260921-v4. Blocked from producing final evidence until the live two-overlapping-transaction isolation proof exists for B1-C0/B1-C2 (BLK-004) and known reinstated-prototype defects (BLK-013) are closed. Runs produced before this revision under the retired status remain diagnostic evidence only and are never pooled with v5 evidence.

not_measured: maximum-throughput or saturation-point claim (E-LOAD reports observed metrics per offered-rate level, never an inferred capacity limit)
10-100 client concurrency beyond the four defined relative rate levels per workload
CPU, RAM, storage, packet-level bandwidth, or network capture (unless separately approved)
claims_not_made: legal compliance, operating effectiveness, or deployment authorization

E-COST.measurement_boundary: first authorization request through access-token issuance
E-COST.b1_f1: measured once per measured batch and reported separately; never added to repeated authorizations
E-COST.failed_attempts: recorded, never replaced by a retry

E-ARTIFACT.description: Exact serialized size and SHA-256 of every observable authorization artifact, and application-level wire bytes per named step
E-ARTIFACT.unavailable_policy: availability=UNAVAILABLE with a specific missing_reason; never estimated

E-LOAD.restart_granularity: the stack is stopped/started once per (model, batch); every rate level in the campaign's rate list runs consecutively in that one lifetime (decision DEC-021, 2026-09-22). Only batch-to-batch transitions restart the stack.
E-LOAD.isolation_gate: BLK-004: CLOSED 2026-09-22. Live isolation-verified proofs exist for B1-C0 and B1-C2 under the current source digest (evaluation/evidence/perf/isolation-proof-b1c0-*, isolation-proof-b1c2-*), produced automatically by run_perf.py/probe_saturation.py's ensure_isolation_proof(). A future source change invalidates the proof and requires regeneration.
E-LOAD.generator_limited_policy: a window with not_started > 0 is disposed GENERATOR_LIMITED and never pooled with COMPLETED windows as server-capacity evidence
E-LOAD.known_defects: BLK-013: 3 defects found and fixed 2026-09-22 (probe_saturation.py referenced removed run_perf.py module constants and did not forward rates/workload to PerfRunner). Verified by live execution. No further defect reproduced; a different defect the author has in mind should be filed as a new blocker.

final_run_guard: A final run fails closed unless the protocol manifest and the configuration are frozen, approval.frozen_digest equals the digest computed from the current protocol, configuration, pairing plan, and fixtures, the source identity is exact, and conformance passed for the exact evaluated source.
